context_before: How do we learn information about you?
We learn information about you when:
- you give it to us directly (e.g., when you choose to send us crash reports);
removed: - we collect it automatically through our products and services (e.g., when your Firefox browser checks with us to see if is up to date);
added: - we collect it automatically through our products and services (e.g., when your Firefox browser checks with us to see if it is up to date);
context_after: - someone else tells us information about you (e.g., when Thunderbird works with your email providers to set up your account); or
- when we try and understand more about you based on information you've given to us (e.g., when we use your IP address to customize language for some of our services).
What do we do with your information once we have it?
